newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia reinstates Putilov as Rosneft chairman.
newsitem.headline: Russia reinstates Putilov as Rosneft chairman.

text.p: The Russian government reinstated Alexander Putilov as chairman of state oil holding company Rosneft on Tuesday, while giving Yuri Bespalov the sole role of president, a senior Rosneft official said on Tuesday.
Putilov was relieved of the joint post of Rosneft chairman and president at the end of last month by the government, and replaced by Bespalov, former industry minister.
"This decree means that Alexander Putilov has been named chairman of the board of directors, and Yuri Bespalov has been named president," Rosneft first vice-president Rair Simonian told reporters.
